proposal.observation: ZN-E010 (AnchoredFade-ResConv-GELU) on split 2021: MAPE 0.3325, Acc@15 0.3665, RMSE 425.0, corr 0.48, gradient gate PASS; selected as the Phase-1 freeze candidate after A5-ZN early closure.
proposal.primary_hypothesis: The ZN-E010 configuration generalises to paper split 2024 with a passing gradient gate; its metrics enter the 3-split mean ± std compared with the paper Zn-ion table.
proposal.question_inherited: Is ZN-E010 confirmed on the other paper splits so it can be frozen as the Phase-1 model?
proposal.unresolved_from_reference: Split dependence and gate health of ZN-E010 on splits 42/2024.
proposal.why_this_experiment: program.md §10 A5: the best candidate needs confirmation before freezing; state.json split_protocol confirms KEEP-level candidates on splits 42 and 2024 (Gemini ZN-E012 analysis selected ZN-E010).
proposal.modification: None vs ZN-E010: identical model and training; only BL_SPLIT=2024.
proposal.held_constant_components: Model (AnchoredFade-ResConv-GELU, 98,113 params) and all training settings fixed from ZN-E010: Relative Huber delta 0.15, Adam lr 5e-4, batch 128, seed 2021, A2-ZN epoch rule, checkpoint rule, preprocessing.
proposal.controlled_variables: Training seed 2021, minimum 5 / maximum 100 epochs, patience 5 after epoch 5, diagnostics every 50 steps. Sole changed variable: split 2024.
proposal.expected_evidence: Split-2024 MAPE, Acc@15, RMSE, DB-MAPE, seen/unseen MAPE (tools/rescore.py), EOL bands, pred SD/corr, gradient gate; contributes to the 3-split mean ± std with ZN-E010 and the other confirmation run.
proposal.rejection_condition: Per-run disposition: VALID with gradient gate PASS -> KEEP (confirmation evidence); VALID with gate FAIL -> DISCARD; protocol/finite/completeness failure -> INVALID, no decision. Candidate-level aggregate (after ZN-E014, over ZN-E010/E013/E014 = splits 2021/42/2024, same config and seed): CONFIRMED iff 3-split mean MAPE < 0.515 (beats paper CPTransformer) AND mean Acc@15 > 0.297 (beats paper CPMLP) AND all three runs KEEP; then ZN-E010 is frozen as the Phase-1 model (TARGET_NOT_MET recorded, A5-ZN) and Phase 2 unlocks. Otherwise NOT CONFIRMED and the lead returns to the user with the next-best candidate.
proposal.minimum_evidence_requirements: At least five complete epochs; finite MAPE, Acc@15, MAE, and RMSE from one checkpoint; sample and unique-cell counts for every domain; gradient, update, activation, prediction, mask, and compute diagnostics.
proposal.required_diagnostics: Epoch learning curve; selected and minimum-MAPE epochs; cycle_stem, residual_blocks, fade_encoder, inter_summary and head gradients and updates; activation health; prediction spread and bias; prefix, domain and EOL errors; padding sensitivity; parameters, memory, time, throughput.

architecture_addendum.evidence: Confirmation of the Phase-1 freeze candidate ZN-E010
architecture_addendum.shapes: [B,100,3,300] -> ResConv [B,100,64] (h_t) -> u_t=[h_t, h_t-h_1] [B,100,128] -> Linear 128->64, GELU, Linear 64->64, +h_t -> g_t [B,100,64] * mask -> masked summary [B,192] -> Linear [B,64] -> GELU -> Linear [B,1]
architecture_addendum.mask_path: h_1 = cycle index 0 (always observed); g_t multiplied by mask; mean over mask==1, last at mask.sum()-1, delta last - first. tests/test_anchored_fade.py: padding invariance and cycle-1 dependence.
architecture_addendum.expected_evidence: Split-2024 MAPE, Acc@15, RMSE, DB-MAPE, seen/unseen MAPE (tools/rescore.py), EOL bands, pred SD/corr, gradient gate; contributes to the 3-split mean ± std with ZN-E010 and the other confirmation run.

proposal.smoke_evidence: Identical code and config to ZN-E010 (Kaggle T4 full run) and ZN-E010S; only the split changes.
